display_name: 32. PAN 조건 특징 변조와 국소 회귀 사전 정보의 빠른 선별

training.start: warm start from A0 best: weights, Adam state, loader RNG

operation.W1: PAN encoder (3x3 1->32, ReLU, 3x3 32->64); 1x1 128->128 scale/shift after resblock 2 and 4; zero init
operation.W1c: same as W1 with guide from backbone input features (1x1 64->32, ReLU, 3x3 32->64)
operation.W2: guided-filter prior at MS scale (r=2, eps=1e-5) applied to PAN; [GF, GF-LMS] via 3x3 into first features; res += gamma_b*(GF_b-LMS_b); zero init

gates.phase0_W2: blend MSE reduction >= 2% on validation second half, or Ds proxy better by >= 0.005
gates.phase1_W1: >=3% better than W0, >=1.5% better than W1c, Ds proxy not worse by >0.002
gates.phase1_W2: >=2% better than W0 or Ds proxy better by >=0.005
